title: HexaLibre
description: Prototyped HexaLibre, a smart library management system for colleges, as part of a 2-person team. Built core modules for QR-based book issuing/returning, college email-based authentication, and real-time book availability tracking. Structured the architecture for scalable backend integration and fine tracking. The prototype lays the groundwork for deployment across institutions with 1,000+ users and 10,000+ books.

title: XeroIMS
description: Independently developed a scalable inventory management system using Spring Boot that efficiently handles up to 50,000+ SKUs with multi-user support. Implemented a responsive dashboard with status tracking and approval workflows that improved operational decision-making time by 20%. Enhanced database performance through JPA repository optimization and table indexing, reducing query execution time by 30% for common inventory operations.
